question:
In the following diagrams, the blue arrows represent transport through the xylem vessels and the red arrows represent transport through the phloem vessels. Which diagram shows the correct direction of transport in the plant stem?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3cebdf8b9224b203800e29b9da20c7d7868615459ef742abad99a32211e77e3c.png]
solution:
The correct answer is__** Diagram B**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 
 **The xylem**.

 
 
• 
 It **transports water and minerals from the roots up the plant stem and into the leaves.**
 
 
• 
 Water molecules are strongly cohesive, meaning they cling to each other through hydrogen bonds.
 
 
• 
 **This gives water the physical properties of solid wires, allowing transpirational pull in the leaves to affect water molecules throughout the xylem.**
 
 
 
 
• **​​The Phloem **
 
 
• **​It **t**ransport can move substances both up and down the plant.**
 
• For example, photosynthates produced in the upper leaves travel up to the growing shoot tip, while photosynthates in the lower leaves travel down to the roots.
 
 
 
• 
 **The most widely accepted theory for phloem transport is the pressure-flow hypothesis**.
 
 
• 
 This theory states that water containing food molecules flows through the phloem under pressure.
 
 
• 
 The **pressure is created by the difference in water concentration between the phloem and the xylem ducts.**
 
 
• 
 
 **Hence Diagram B is correct **
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4bcd8e8034bfd5ae25fc97b91c8158864ed2d032f5ac133c420f72554073391b.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Functions of plant tissues:__

 
 
• Plant tissues have different functions depending upon their structure and location
 
• Help provide mechanical strength to organs.
 
• They help in providing elasticity and flexibility to the organs.
 
• They help the tissues to bend easily in various parts of a plant like- leaf, stem, and branches without damaging the plant
 
• The xylem and phloem tissues help in the transportation of material throughout the plants
 
• They divide to produce new cells and help in the growth of the plants.
 
• They help in various cellular metabolisms like photosynthesis, regeneration, respiration, etc.
